descriptions.archers_expansion:fast_shot: Your next shots give you ranged haste.
descriptions.archers_expansion:bouncing_arrow: An arrow that bounces from target to target.
descriptions.archers_expansion:disabling_shot: Damages and slows the target and makes you jump back.
descriptions.archers_expansion:choking_gas: Creates a poisonous gas cloud where the arrow hits.
descriptions.archers_expansion:venom_cask: Throws a cask of venom that damages on impact and leaves a poisonous cloud.
descriptions.archers_expansion:alter_ego: Creates exploding decoys and makes you invisible.
descriptions.archers_expansion:frozen_shot: Your next shots stack Frosted on targets, slowing and finally freezing them.
descriptions.archers_expansion:frozen_pact: Damages the target based on how frozen it is and reduces its attack.
descriptions.archers_expansion:arctic_volley: Shoots a volley of arctic arrows that damage and frost targets.
descriptions.archers_expansion:enchanted_crystal_arro: Damages, stuns and freezes the target.
descriptions.archers_expansion:bearward: Summons a Polar Bear that fights by your side, empowered by your ranged damage.
descriptions.archers_expansion:frozen_fusillade: A barrage of ice around you that slows nearby enemies and speeds up allies.
descriptions.archers_expansion:smoldering_arrow: Your next shot creates a small explosion that damages and burns nearby enemies.
descriptions.archers_expansion:point_blank_shot: Damages and knocks back the target, stronger the closer it is.
descriptions.archers_expansion:pin_down: Damages the target and stops it from moving or jumping.
descriptions.archers_expansion:scorched_earth: Fires a bolt that sets a line of ground on fire.
descriptions.archers_expansion:explosive_barrel: Places a barrel that explodes when hit or approached by an enemy and sets enemies on fire.
